from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class BuildingPermitRecord(BaseModel):
    """A specific monthly SAAR data point extracted from a single release."""
    data_month: str | None = Field(description="The month the data applies to, e.g., '2022-08'")
    saar_value: float | None = Field(description="The Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate (SAAR) for total building permits")
    report_release_date: str | None = Field(description="The date the report containing this data was released (YYYY-MM-DD)")
    is_preliminary: bool | None = Field(description="Whether the SAAR value is marked as preliminary")
    methodology_notes: str | None = Field(description="Any notes about methodology changes affecting this release")
    source_report_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of document (e.g., 'Monthly Statistical Release', 'Press Release')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    building_permit_records: list[BuildingPermitRecord]
